name: Fatigue
overview: Scripture acknowledges the reality of physical and spiritual fatigue but reveals that true renewal comes from the Lord. God Himself rested and was refreshed after creation, setting a divine example for rest (Exodus 31:17). When our strength fails, God is our sustaining rock and source of power, granting renewed strength to the weary (Psalms 73:26; Isaiah 40:29). Those who patiently wait on the Lord will experience a divine exchange of weakness for vigor, enabling them to rise and endure without fainting (Isaiah 40:31). Moreover, the Lord promises continual guidance and satisfaction that sustains even in the driest seasons, likening the believer to a well-watered garden (Isaiah 58:11). While Proverbs warns against excessive sleep, Scripture overall directs believers to depend on God’s strength rather than their own in overcoming fatigue (Proverbs 20:13).
